title: Contact
author: Carl Sagan
description: A radio astronomer detects a signal from Vega, and the world has to decide what to do with a message it did not expect.
reasons: want expansive sci-fi that takes first contact seriously
like stories where science and religion actually argue
want a scientist heroine written by a scientist
are more interested in the idea of aliens than in aliens
dislikes: It is slow, with long stretches of committee meetings and politics
